item.title: Committee backs reversing CVS zoning denial
item.description: RACINE — CVS could have another shot at building a store at the corner of Ohio Street and Washington Avenue after a vote taken Tuesday by the City Council’s Committee of the Whole.

item.title: Number cruncher: Union Grove's Pettit produces in different ways
item.description: There’s just something about numbers that Frankie Pettit finds enticing.

item.title: Balow invented, fostered innovation in others
item.description: MOUNT PLEASANT — Bob Balow wasn’t a Racine native, but he embodied the city’s historical spirit of innovation.

item.title: Bucks' rally, but lose third of last four
item.description: MILWAUKEE — Jordan Hill had 19 points and the Indiana Pacers survived a last-minute rally to defeat the Milwaukee Bucks 104-99 on Wednesday night to end a three-game losing streak.

item.title: Annual Thoughts for Food set for Saturday
item.description: They’ve done it again. Organizers of Racine’s annual Thoughts for Food event have managed to pack close to 50 different musical acts into one night of entertainment and goodwill on Saturday, March 5.

item.title: Retired UW-Parkside wrestling coach seriously injured in accident
item.description: ST. LOUIS — Former Ranger wrestling coach Jim Koch was in critical condition at a St. Louis hospital on Saturday evening after being struck by a car Friday morning.

item.title: Racine second-grader vying to break BMX world record
item.description: RACINE — At age 1, Brody Ervin started riding a Strider no-pedal bike. By 2, he was able to ride a two-wheel bike with no training wheels.
